An '''underground city''' existed on the planetoid [[Zygerria Four]] at some point before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. After the [[Bombardment of Zygerria Four|orbital bombardment]] of Zygerria Four, the ruins of the city were uncovered.<ref name="In the Wake">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Scavenging|In the Wake}}</ref>
